description: Unsubscribe a subscriber while preserving the record and suppression history. Only permanently deletes when hardDelete is true.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

externalId.description: Customer-owned subscriber ID. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

hardDelete.description: If true, permanently deletes the subscriber; usually within an hour their activity history and Sent emails records are erased and their delivery and engagement events anonymized, while bounce and spam-complaint suppressions keep the address. Defaults to false, which globally unsubscribes the contact, deactivates list memberships, and cancels active sequence enrollments.

name: remove_subscriber

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `remove_subscriber` MCP tool.

hardDeleted.description: Whether the subscriber was permanently deleted.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

subscriber.description: The subscriber record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
